title: App-only seam mechanics: change notification and driving setup
appHalf: RM-23 is a new adapter mechanism: Backend.subscribe plus invalidation keyed by source (config, clone:<team>, placed, stamp:<team>), revalidate-on-visible, a low-frequency poll of the two cheap local reads, an explicit Sync now, a ≥250 ms debounce ignoring .lock directories and config.json.<pid>.<uuid>.tmp files, and NO optimistic cache writes.
